messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — trace export failures to New Relic ingestion detected. Root cause suspected: vendor-side throttling (429s). Paging @jamie @maria @alex. Incident id: 1867001234

jamie: seeing a sustained spike of 429s from the newrelic OTLP exporter in the trace-shipper logs. example: 
```
2026-03-15T15:02:12Z trace-shipper[pid=2145] exporter=newrelic status=429 body=\"ingestion rate limit\" span_count=120
2026-03-15T15:02:13Z trace-shipper[pid=2145] exporter=newrelic status=429 body=\"quota exceeded\" span_count=98
```

maria: any customer impact visible in the UI or errors?

jamie: no user-facing 500s. App traffic OK. Impact: ~8-12% of traces dropped, tracing-based SLOs and a handful of recent deploy-related correlation alerts will be noisy/missing. Downstream dashboards relying on full trace coverage will show gaps.

alex: confirmed, Honeycomb fallback is configured for a subset but not enabled as a hot-failover. New Relic is returning 429s with Retry-After sometimes. Looks vendor-side (ingestion throttling).

jamie: mitigation plan (short):
- reduce tracing sampling from 100% -> 10% for high-volume services (immediately)
- enable local disk buffering on trace-shipper and increase exporter backoff windows
- temporarily route a small percentage of traffic to Honeycomb as fallback for high-priority services
- notify customers using tracing-based alerts that traces may be incomplete

Commands I will run now: 
```
# reduce sampling via configmap patch
kubectl -n infra patch configmap trace-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/sampling_rate","value":"0.10"}]'
# restart shipper to pick up sampling change
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/trace-shipper
```

maria: OK taking secondary oncall. I'll monitor New Relic ingestion and error budget graphs. @sre-bot can you raise debug logs for the shipper export path for 30m?

sre-bot: debug logging: trace-shipper exporter path enabled for 30m.

alex: I'll toggle local disk buffer and bump retries/backoff. Patch to shipper config: 
```
exporter:
  newrelic:
    buffer:
      enabled: true
      path: /var/lib/trace-buffer
    retry:
      max_interval: 60s
      initial_interval: 2s
      max_retries: 10
```

jamie: Applied sampling patch, rollout succeeded. Initial metrics: outgoing spans to New Relic dropped ~70% (expected). Error rate of exporter still shows intermittent 429s but backlog building should reduce over next 10-15m.

ops-bot: Noted: customer-facing metrics unaffected. Observability slices: traces missing for ~10% of sampled requests.

maria: I'll notify the support rotation to field any tracing questions from customers. Draft message: "We're seeing intermittent trace export throttling to our New Relic vendor causing gaps in traces and dashboards. No user-facing errors. We're mitigating by reducing sampling and enabling buffering; we'll provide updates in 30m." Approve?

jamie: LGTM. Send. :thumbsup:

alex: routing a 5% traffic slice to Honeycomb as a fallback for the highest priority services now. Monitoring ingress to ensure no double-counting.

jamie: handing on-call to @maria at 15:40 UTC — I'm stepping off after a short overlap. Handoff notes: sampling reduced, buffer enabled, Honeycomb fallback active, watching exporter backlog and New Relic Retry-After headers.

maria: I have the handoff. I'll keep incident open until stable for 2h. Can the infra runbook owner create a postmortem ticket and include vendor contact logs + Retry-After headers?

ops-bot: Postmortem ticket created: PM-4572. Assigned to infra-runbooks.

jamie: final: will follow up with vendor support thread (ticket #NR-9987) — sending requested logs and sample Retry-After headers. Timeline and mitigations will go into the postmortem. Good job team. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: closing updates for now — monitoring. If New Relic clears throttling and exporter error rate returns to baseline, we'll mark mitigated and update the postmortem.

sre-bot: Incident state: mitigations applied, monitoring in progress. Reminder: collect trace gaps sample set for the postmortem.

ops-bot: Will keep incident open until 17:40 UTC per handoff.

jamie: thanks all.
